problem: Suppose that a matrix $B$ has characteristic polynomial $p(\lambda )=(5-\lambda )^{3}(3+\lambda )^{9}(\lambda -\pi )^{6},$ the nullity of $(B-\pi I)^{3}$ equals $3,$ and the nullity of $(B-\pi I)^{4}$ equals $5.$ If a basis of ${R}^{18}$ consists of linearly independent generalized eigenvectors of $B$, how many of these are generalized eigenvectors of rank $4$ corresponding to the eigenvalue $\lambda =\pi ?$
